create_scene3d: create a Scene3D instance to serve as the root container for 3D scene graph objects
create_object3d: create an Object3D instance attached to a Scene3D or parent Object3D in the scene graph
test_rotate_local: test rotating an Object3D locally around the X axis by 35 degrees using rotate_local
test_translate: test translating an Object3D by a 3D vector using the translate method
test_absolute_transformation: test the absolute_transformation method to verify parent-child transformation matrix composition in the scene graph
